basis: Expected values for the production rows csharp-B03 (expressions and patterns) and csharp-B04 (statements), derived without any native output. An alternative of group A (a literal anchor, basis spec-derived) expects a node of the types of each anchor token, spanning exactly that token, at the tightest ordered run of the required keyword and punctuation tokens in an accepted source of a linked case; it does not assert the node that holds the anchors (decision D-1). An alternative of group B (a Roslyn structure, basis differential-oracle) expects a node of the kind map's types for the classified Roslyn kinds with exactly the span of the first such node of an accepted source of a linked case. An alternative of group C is BLOCKED with a reason code. discriminating false is a weak match: an anchor of single punctuation characters, a type that other Roslyn kinds share, or a type set that holds identifier or five or more types. The single-oracle limit applies: a differential-oracle expectation is the behavior of one Roslyn build, not the specification. The position audit and the type audit of this revision are separate assets. Revision r2 is the sealed r1 expected asset with the corrections listed in `corrections`, made after the native comparison and each with its grounds in the specification and grammar text (after_native true, basis_independent true); r1 is unchanged. The counts of `post_seal` are the post-seal corrections, apart from the expectations made before the seal.

corrections.reason: The sealed types of the anchor `var` are the kind map's types for the Roslyn IdentifierToken observed there (identifier, implicit_parameter), a context-free list that is right for an identifier. In this alternative `var` is the implicit type of a declaration: the pinned grammar text defines implicit_type: 'var' and lists implicit_type in type, so the types the grammar gives the lexeme are the named node implicit_type and its anonymous token "var". The type audit r2 derives the same set from the grammar text alone. Here `var` is the type of a declaration expression (local_variable_type of 12.20).

corrections.reason: The sealed expectation (a node parenthesized_variable_designation with the span of the nested designation) holds for the pattern contexts of the alternative, but its only witness is the nested designation of `var (a, (b, c)) = ...`. There the pinned grammar text has variable_declarator choose between a name and a tuple_pattern, and tuple_pattern nests tuple_pattern, so the grammar's node is a tuple_pattern and parenthesized_variable_designation does not occur. Roslyn's kind and the grammar's node are not one to one in this context, and a second witness in a pattern context is a new expectation, not a correction. The alternative is BLOCKED with the registered code POSITION_DEPENDENT (the node is decided by the slot), the code the classification gives the other alternatives whose node depends on the slot (tuple_element).
